## GET `/api/2.29/logs`

**Tier:** T0  

Download a history of log events from the array to provide to Pure Technical Services for analysis.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `end_time` | query | integer (int64) |  | When the time window ends (in milliseconds since epoch). |
| `start_time` | query | integer (int64) |  | When the time window starts (in milliseconds since epoch). |

**Responses:** `200` OK
